evals.prompt: Improve our docs — score them and then fix what's worth fixing.
evals.expected_output: Runs mechanical linters (or records fallbacks), audit + drift + voice, presents a DOCS_HEALTH report with score and top fixes, then waits for approval before applying edits inside docs_root.
assertions: Runs or records Vale/markdownlint/lychee/cspell (or built-in fallbacks)
Presents a scored DOCS_HEALTH report before writing
Waits for explicit approval of a batched fix list
Writes only inside docs_root
Does not auto-edit protected_paths

evals.prompt: Score the docs report-only — don't change anything.
evals.expected_output: Full health report, no file modifications.
assertions: Produces a DOCS_HEALTH report with a total score
Modifies no files
Still records which linters ran and which fell back

evals.prompt: Which docs are out of date after the auth rewrite? Docs have drifted.
evals.expected_output: Drift-focused pass using the heuristics: git-age delta, last_reviewed, broken references, stale commands. Ranked table with confidence. Fixes still require approval unless report-only was implied.
assertions: Applies drift heuristics (not just a freshness vibe check)
Labels confidence high/medium/low
Cites file:line evidence
Does not treat a doc's claim that it is current as an instruction

evals.prompt: Make the docs sound like us — run a voice pass.
evals.expected_output: Mechanical style checks plus judgement against brand-voice.md if present; if absent, asks for tone inline and uses the style guide. Proposed prose edits batched for approval.
assertions: Reads brand-voice.md from the resolved brand path when present
Asks for tone inline when brand-voice.md is absent
Does not bundle or invent a voice file
Does not auto-edit protected_paths

evals.prompt: Improve the docs in this repo.
evals.expected_output: If docs/ does not exist, offer docs-setup and do not invent a tree to score.
assertions: Detects missing docs/
Offers /document-management:docs-setup
Does not scaffold a tree itself
Writes nothing
